title: Department of State cleared report governs what Brown can say

tellings.quote: largely based on the department of state cleared report and then inferences drawn from that report.

plain: A former government official turned whistleblower named Matthew Brown says that what he is free to say in public rests on a report the Department of State has cleared for release. He tells Michels that his account is "largely based on the department of state cleared report and then inferences drawn from that report," which marks the line between what the document backs and what he concludes himself.
